intent: The public marketing-page shell: sticky header, a hero with one media slot, a content well, and a footer.
guidance: Fills the marketing surface top to bottom while holding no product, auth, or routing state — the host wires the CTAs and fills the copy. The scroll container is deliberate: the template owns the scrollport and its content grows with the page, which is what keeps the header sticky the whole way down. Keep exactly one media slot, at the top, holding a stable 1320:693 frame for the launch film; the sections below are copy-only (DEC-073). Mark the redundant 'Log in' link with data-landing-collapsible so it hides below a 368px header and the primary CTA never clips. This surface is fixed-light and is not themed.
use_when: The public / marketing entry surface that routes a visitor toward authentication.
A full-page content surface that needs a sticky header, a hero, and a footer.
dont_use_when: An authenticated app screen — use ProjectsHomeTemplate or EditorShell.
A dialog or panel — this owns a whole scroll page, not a region.

anatomy.description: Brand mark + a collapsible action row (the host wires the signed-out vs. authenticated swap); the redundant link collapses below a 368px header.
Beta tag, headline, sub-copy, CTA row, then the one media slot — a stable 1320:693 frame for the launch film.
The host's copy-only value / capability / final-CTA / FAQ sections; the template owns the page rhythm around them.
A centered line between the content and the footer (e.g. "Not affiliated with Figma").

states: authenticated (CTAs read "Continue as <name>"; Log in hidden)
media-pending (the reserved neutral frame renders without layout shift)

slots.headerActions: Header action row; the host owns the auth-state swap.
slots.title: Hero headline.
slots.subtitle: Hero sub-copy.

tokens.note: A fixed-light marketing surface: it uses raw white/black and the landing spec's measured rgba values (e.g. shadows), not the themed c-* token set — so it is intentionally not fully token-bound.

a11y.keyboard: focus follows document order; visible focus is required
a11y.motion: respects prefers-reduced-motion; the media slot's film is host-owned
a11y.note: The media slot needs an accessible label from the host; the header/main/footer are semantic landmarks.
